{{Quote|The Republic will never stop opposing you.|Shai to the Imperial who killed him|<ref name="A New Order">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|A New Order|Ilum}}</ref>}}
'''Shai''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] and one of the commanders of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] military efforts on [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] during the [[Battle of Ilum|fighting]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He saw endless war for all his life and had grown very tired of it and hoped that Ilum would be the changing point of the conflict. He witnessed the Imperials kill the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Jaric Kaedan]] and later tried to destroy the entire Imperial force on Ilum at once with the experimental [[ELX-25 prototype long-range cannon|ELX-25 long-range cannon]].<ref name="SUD">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Shoring up Defenses|[[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]]}}</ref> 

{{GameDS}}
When confronted in the Republic base by an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] hero, Shai states that the Empire's efforts were futile; even if the Empire uses Ilum's [[Adegan crystal/Legends|Adegan Crystals]] to construct their stealth armada, the Republic will find a way to detect and destroy it, starting a cycle of creating superweapons until both superpowers annihilate each other or the galaxy. He then activated ray shields around himself and summoned his troops to attack the invader, but the Imperial managed to kill them all and destroy the shield generators. Despite being wounded, Shai defiantly proclaims that his death would not stop the Republic resistance, vowing that the Empire will fail because it tramples on freedom, whereas the Republic pull the weak up and become stronger as a result. The Imperial ignored his prattle and executed him.<ref name="A New Order" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|The Empire will fail because it insists on being a set of individuals rather than a true citizenship. Because it insists on pushing everyone to the margins. We pull the weak up, and become stronger as a result.|Shai's last words|<ref name="A New Order" />}}
Having dedicated his life to fighting the Sith Empire, Shai recognized that the continuing escalation and believed that the conflict could only end one way - with both sides eventually developing technology to annihilate one another and destroy the galaxy.<ref>{{TORcite|type=codex|Admiral Shai}}</ref>

Shai rejects the Imperial methodology of assassinating the Republic leadership to be foolhardy, holding to his faith in the strength of the Republic citizens.<ref name="SUD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Shai is a characters in the 2011 ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' video game, available during the Imperial Ilum missions.

Shai's fate is decided two ways:
*The player executes him (dark side dialogue)<ref name="A New Order" />
*The player takes him prisoner (light side dialogue)<ref name="A New Order" />
